title: Reassigned to Kilo control and never team leader again

tellings.quote: never went back to no Wimer control they sent me to kilo control

plain: A former guard at a nuclear missile field named Mario Woods says that after the night he describes as a UFO abduction in 1977, near Ellsworth in South Dakota, he was moved for good. He says he "never went back" to the post he had been working, Wimer control, and was sent to another post in the missile field called Kilo control. He says he was never made team leader again, which he tells as a sign that the event quietly changed his career.
